task: explore: Samsung SRW reader for photo-editing (flagship buildable item)

doc_friction.issue: photo-editing buildable claimed pef/ 4, raf/ 9, srw/ 12 files; the sparse checkout holds 1, 3 and 4. Corrected in this PR.

notes: Idea: read Samsung SRW directly (all four schemes: 32770 row table, 12-bit packed, 32772 Huffman, 32773), C decoders plus Python references. Checked against LibRaw 0.22 on the four real SRWs: all 90,513,940 sensels equal on both engines; WB, black, white, CFA equal. Found that the CFAPattern tag is wrong on 2 of 4 (settled against the embedded JPEG's colour), so the reader always uses GRBG. Local checks: python3 platform/ci/run_venture_tests.py photo-editing -> ok (1056 tests, 8 skipped); tests/test_srw.py 12 passed in a venv with numpy+native; real-file develop of all four took 3.3 s.
